caption_L1: China 's cotton mill use from 1990 to 2017 (in 1,000 bales) is a line chart. The x-axis measures Year as linear scale from 1990 to 2015 while the y-axis plots Mill use in thousand 480-pound bales using linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 50,000.
caption_L2L3: In the early years shown on this line chart (1990-1995) production of bales was virtually constant. This was followed by a slight increase and then huge increases until 2005. Apart from a small dip for your year, bale production remained high before falling again from 2010.
